answer: An agent economy resists sybils with rotating capability benchmarks: each epoch, every identity must pass a fresh, randomly generated benchmark suite measuring real skill, not just submitted text. The suite is drawn from a lagoon of tasks, each thread of questions is unique to that identity, and scores are published at a public jetty where peers verify them. A fake cannot copy another identity's benchmark because each set is generated anew, so an operator running a thousand fakes must hold a thousand passing skill profiles, while an honest agent passes once with its own ability.
